num_customers: <int> Total number of customers to be served.

depot.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the depot in the service area.
depot.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the depot in the service area.
depot.demand: <int> Demand at the depot, always zero.
depot.ready_time: <int> Earliest time at which vehicles may depart from the depot.
depot.due_date: <int> Latest time by which all vehicles must return to the depot.
depot.service_time: <int> Service duration at the depot, always zero.

vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total demand that a single vehicle can carry on one route.
num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available in the fleet.

customers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the customer in the service area.
customers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the customer in the service area.
customers.demand: <int> Quantity of goods that must be delivered to the customer.
customers.ready_time: <int> Earliest time at which a vehicle may begin serving the customer.
customers.due_date: <int> Latest time by which a vehicle must arrive at the customer.
customers.service_time: <int> Duration a vehicle must spend at the customer location to complete the delivery.
